name: pythia-cognitive-os
description: Disciplined reasoning and execution layer. Context retention, evidence discipline, anti-hallucination controls, mastery-level coding behavior. MCP is transport only. Intelligence remains inside the repository.

tools.name: session_start
tools.description: Initialize a session. Mandatory skills activated. Working context snapshot recorded. Proof of context loaded is required before any claim.

tools.name: evidence_verify
tools.description: Verify that claimed evidence exists and matches its digest. Boolean-only evidence is rejected. Unknown equals unavailable.

tools.name: completion_gate
tools.description: Refuse completion unless context is loaded, evidence is retrieved, verification is executed, and tests pass. No claim without verification. No completion without tests.

tools.name: owner_approval
tools.description: Record an owner approval gate. Owner decision overrides interpretation. Required for canonical writes.
